name: price-three-option-proposal
description: Writes the price section of a proposal with one to three real options that differ in scope and outcome, the fee by phase from your own numbers, the assumptions the price rests on, plain terms and dated next steps, with no decoy, anchor or deadline. Use for "run price-three-option-proposal", "give the client options", "good better best proposal", "write the fee section", "how do I present the price", "stop sending one number", "build the options for this client", part of the Pricing Under AI Pressure Pack by 90n.
